title: Poseit promo: stock footage catalogue
purpose: Free stock clips of real people for the promo film, where the app's graphics (detected skeleton, white mannequin guide, score ring, hint cards, frame marks, countdown, flash) become overlays on real footage. Needs: (a) one person, full body, posing for a camera and moving between poses, then holding one (the live-coaching act, run through the app's real detection and matcher); (b) different people in clear poses that match library categories, for fast pose-matched cuts; (c) someone photographing a friend with a phone, and reactions; (d) only if clearly acted and kind: someone unsure in front of a camera.
rules: Never commit stock video (raw or transcoded). Previews live in promo/out/stock/ (gitignored); full-size clips go to promo/public/footage/ (*.mp4 and src/ are gitignored). Commit only this catalogue, scripts, credits and derived data.

The people are stock models: no names, no quotes or captions that put words in their mouths, nothing that presents them as users or reviewers endorsing Poseit, nothing that mocks them or shows them in a bad light. Generic on-screen copy in the app's voice is fine.
Mixkit: only items whose own page says Mixkit Stock Video Free License. Items under the Mixkit Stock Video Restricted License are personal-use only and are listed under excluded.
Coverr: only stock-library items with isPremium false and isAiGenerated false (AI-generated people are not real humans; premium items, which include Coverr's vertical footage, need a paid plan).

coverr.caveat_ai_training: General rules: "Nothing from Coverr may be used to train, fine-tune, distill or evaluate AI models, or go into a dataset for that purpose." Running the app's pose model over a clip to draw the app's overlays is using the footage in a video, not training or evaluating a model, and the landmark JSON is not a training dataset. Still, the detection statistics in this catalogue are a footage-suitability check, and a cautious reading would keep Coverr clips to roles that need no detection (need c cutaways) and use Mixkit clips for the detected acts (needs a and b).

method.search: Mixkit tag pages (posing, model, fashion, photographer, selfie, full-body) and search pages (https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/discover/<query>/: pose, posing, model-posing, photoshoot, taking-photo, woman-posing, man-posing, couple-posing, friends-taking-photo, fashion-model, full-body, phone-photo, shy, awkward, nervous, confused, group-photo and others): 1,194 unique items read from the grids. Coverr search pages (https://coverr.co/s?q=<query>: posing, model, photoshoot, taking photos, photographs friend, taking photo phone, selfie, posing for photo, fashion model, full body, photo shoot studio, dancing studio): 269 items, of which 54 premium and 30 AI-generated were dropped.
method.previews: 360p previews of 56 candidates (43 Mixkit, 13 Coverr) in promo/out/stock/<id>.mp4; a 12-frame contact sheet per clip in promo/out/stock/sheets/<id>.jpg (timestamps burned in), each looked at.
method.detection: promo/scripts/detect.py with the app's live-analyzer model: app/src/main/assets/models/pose_landmarker_lite.task (Settings > accurate model is off by default; PoseDetector.kt MODEL_LITE), min detection/presence/tracking confidence 0.5, frames fed un-mirrored, VIDEO running mode (the app uses LIVE_STREAM on camera frames; VIDEO keeps the same tracking for a file). num_poses 4 to count people (the app uses the guide's person count). Run on every 360p preview; the strongest need-(a) clips and the landscape clips that need a 9:16 crop were also run at 720p, and the top three with the full model too.
method.stats: detection_rate: frames with a person. full_body_rate: frames where the followed person's hips, knees and ankles average visibility >= 0.6, both ankles >= 0.5 and the nose >= 0.5. lower_body_visibility_mean: mean visibility of hips, knees, ankles. people_max/mode: people found. pose_speed: mean angular speed of 10 segments (8 limb bones, shoulder line, hip line) over a 0.25 s lag, deg/s; jitter on a still body is about 3-8, a clear move 40+. holds: full body and pose speed < 15 deg/s for >= 0.5 s. transitions: the stretches between holds. Followed person: the largest, or (subject fullest) the most fully visible, for over-the-shoulder shots.
method.rerun: promo/.venv/bin/python promo/scripts/detect.py promo/out/stock/<id>.mp4 -o promo/out/stock/landmarks/<id>.json --summary promo/out/stock/summary/<id>.json --num-poses 4 [--subject fullest] [--crop x,0,w,1]

ranking_need_a.why: Vertical 1080x1920, locked-off, one person filling 0.78 of the frame height with head and feet in, on a plain sky and flat ground: the overlays read cleanly. The app's lite model finds her in every frame with hips, knees and ankles at 0.98 mean visibility. She moves through three clearly different front-facing poses with clean transitions: arms down (hold 0.96-3.58 s at 720p), a fast move (3.58-5.42 s, peak 121 deg/s), both hands behind the head (hold 5.42-7.88 s), then a slower change to one hand high and one behind the head (hold 9.21-10.54 s). Free Mixkit licence. Limits: 10.7 s; the loose dress hides the knees a little; desert at dusk, not a studio.
ranking_need_a.use: The live-coaching act: the guide over her, the score climbing through the arm move at 3.6-5.4 s, the lock and countdown over the 5.4-7.9 s hold.

ranking_need_a.why: Vertical 1080x1920, locked-off, a real photo shoot (pink paper backdrop, softbox and stands in frame), full body in every frame (0.98). Five or six holds at 720p, the longest hands in pockets 2.71-5.38 s and a hand in her hair with one knee bent 11.12-12.67 s, with clear moves between (5.38-8.42 s, 8.96-11.12 s). Free Mixkit licence. Limits: she is 0.43 of the frame height, so filling the frame like mk-34404 needs about a 1.6x push-in, which upscales a 675x1200 window of the 1080x1920 source (slightly soft); studio gear is busy at the edges.
ranking_need_a.use: The same act in a studio setting, or the pose-matched cuts.

ranking_need_a.why: White seamless studio, the nearest real match to the film's studio paper, locked-off, landscape: a 9:16 crop around her (x 0.305-0.621) and she fills 0.71 of its height. The page offers 720p and 1080p, so that crop is 608x1080 source pixels, a 1.78x upscale to 1080x1920 (soft; a 3840x2160 file answers on Mixkit's CDN but the page does not offer it). Full body in every frame; eight holds at 720p (0.13-4.00 s, 9.26-10.68 s, 15.06-16.85 s the longest), front-facing, slow and calm. Free Mixkit licence. Limits: the poses are subtle (hands at the collar and hip, a weight shift) rather than big shapes, and she wears a sheer veil with red sequins across the face that the same shoot's other Mixkit pages describe as resembling blood splatter; fine at full-body size, not for a face crop.
ranking_need_a.use: The coaching act if the film wants the studio world; also the B2-style 'stiff' standing start.

ranking_need_a.why: The only clip that is both the user's moment and a clean need (a) body: a crouching friend photographs her with a phone while she poses full length (arms spread wide, hands at her sides); in a 9:16 crop around her she is alone, full body in every frame, 7 holds. Coverr licence (free, non-premium, not AI). Its licence bars using content to 'evaluate AI models'; drawing the app's overlays is not that, but the cautious choice is a Mixkit clip for the detected act.

Vertical, locked-off, full body in every frame with the biggest, most distinct shapes (arms spread wide, hands in pockets, a turn), but only short holds (0.5-1.0 s) and a strong magenta grade that fights the Studio greys.

countdown_note: No candidate holds still for the app's full 700 ms hold plus 3 s countdown (about 3.7 s) right after a move: the longest post-move holds are 2.46 s (mk-34404), 2.67 s (mk-39676) and 1.79 s (mk-52257). The hold-and-countdown beat will need the hold slowed (about 0.6x), a held frame, or the countdown compressed in the edit; the matcher's verdicts should then be computed on the retimed footage.
